utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: We were discussing our situation.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Yes. Yes. And presumably trying to find problems -- sorry - solutions to the problems that you faced.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Witness inaudible. MR. DI FAZIO: I heard the witness say "da," and I assume that --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. Can you repeat the answer?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I would like to ask Mr. Di Fazio to ask the question again, because -- MR. DI FAZIO:

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: No. All I'm saying is: The Executive Board was trying to find solutions to the problems faced -- that you faced, and you answered yes. That is so, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Now, in the time that the Executive Board was up and running as a functioning body, was Bozo Ninkovic participating in meetings from time to time, participating in its processes? And I'm talking about April, May, June, July.

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: I can't remember Bozo Ninkovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Do you mean you don't know --

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: I can't remember that he actually took part.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Other members of the Executive Board took part in its deliberations, its proceedings?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: Few members of the Executive Board, rather few, really, took part in the work. In addition to the president or chairman of the Executive Board, there was always Mirko Lukic, most often, that is, not always. If I wasn't there, one of my deputies would attend, most usually Milan Simic, and there was a man whose name I didn't know. He was in charge of property and land surveying. He hailed from Slatina, I think.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: So individual members of the Executive Board could send their deputies to meetings of the board; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: Yes, that's correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: Can the witness be given Exhibit P124, please, I suppose 124 ter, the gazette.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: This document that you have before you is the Official Gazette of the Samac municipality, published in early -- sorry - mid-1994, and it sets out the decisions and some of the legislation adopted by the municipal -- Serbian Municipal Assembly of Bosanski Samac. Can you please go to paragraph 13 of the gazette, and it's at the bottom of that section. It's dated the 14th of April, 1992, and apparently it's got the president of the Executive Council's name, Mirko Jovanovic, after it. Do you see that section, 13? It deals with the steps to form the municipal Crisis Staff. Do you see that?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: Page 11?

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: It's number 02/13 of 92 and it's dated 14th of April, 1992, and next to it is the name Mirko Jovanovic. Do you have that?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: Signed by.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Yes, yes, signed by.

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: And you see it refers to a meeting taken -- that occurred on the 14th of April. And on the 14th of April, the Executive Council of the Serbian municipality passed the following conclusions. Do you see that preamble to -- and then all the six conclusions are set out. Do you see that?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: Yes. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Okay. All right. Now, were you at that meeting on the 14th of April, when the Executive Board passed those conclusions?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Do you know about that meeting on the 14th of April, when the Executive Board passed those conclusions?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: No, I do not know about it, and I assume that the members of the Executive Board, if such a meeting was indeed held, were the same ones who were members of the multiparty Executive Board. This strikes me as slightly illogical, I mean that the Executive Board should set up a body superior to itself. This all strikes me as very dubious, that this might have been done precisely in this manner.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: You don't accept that there was a meeting on the 14th of April at which the Executive Council of the Serbian municipality of Bosanski Samac, at its sixth session, passed all those conclusions? You don't accept that, or at least you have serious doubts about that?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: I don't know that. I don't know about this meeting, so I can't say anything about this meeting.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Do you know when the Crisis Staff was formed?

utterances.speaker: LAZAR MIRKIC
utterances.text: I assume after the 17th of April that the Crisis Staff was established, after the 17th of April, because I do know that there was an intention for the Assembly to continue its work. However, that proved impossible, on account of most of the deputies having been mobilised into the ranks of the army and the police, or elsewhere, and they had to reach some kind of solution. They reached this solution.

utterances.speaker: MR. DI
utterances.text: Thank you. MR. DI FAZIO: It's time, I think, if Your Honours please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
utterances.text: Yes. We'll adjourn now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MUMBA
